children.value: > Fact From Story: The last time India welcomed the ODI Cricket World Cup was in 2011, when they were co-hosts with Sri Lanka and Bangladesh.
> > Fact From Story: It was also the first time two Asian teams were in the finals, as India became the first country to win a World Cup at home by defeating Sri Lanka in the decider.
> > > Fact From Story: The 2011 World Cup was a tournament of many firsts.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Any tournament has a final match.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A country that defeats another country in the final match of the world cup, has hosted the world cup.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Winning a world cup means winning the final match.
